description: Election Commission - Mrs. H. P. D. Perera of the Horana Urban Council has Vacated her Office of member of that Horana Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Horana Urban Council has vacated her office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance specifically concerning the status of an elected official, making it directly related to electoral processes and falling under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
